job.job_description:
Dear Candidate,




Greetings!!




Role: Full Stack Databricks Apps Developer




Location: PAN India


Experience: 4-9 Years




Job Summary:




Develop and deploy scalable business applications on the Databricks platform, combining full stack development skills with data engineering, analytics, and cloud technologies.



4+ years of Python and/or Node.js development experience
2+ years of hands-on Databricks experience
Strong knowledge of PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Workflows
Experience with Unity Catalog and Databricks SQL Warehouses
HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern UI frameworks such as ReactJS
Experience building applications using Streamlit, Dash, or similar frameworks
Knowledge of REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, and DevOps practices
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms



Responsibilities:

Build and deploy Databricks Apps and data-driven business applications
Develop frontend interfaces and backend services integrated with Databricks
Create data pipelines, dashboards, and analytics solutions
Collaborate with business, data engineering, and architecture teams
Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and governance



Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with GenAI and AI/BI capabilities
Strong stakeholder communication skills




Interested candidates can share profile on divya.bisht@siroclinpharm.com
